d: Anthropic's $81 billion IPO has created a massive wealth windfall for its employees, with an estimated 5,100 now holding shares worth over $1 million. Nearly 600 could be worth more than $100 million. The Claude maker also allowed some employees to sell up to 10% of their shares from the first day of trading. The windfall could have wider effects, including boosting San Francisco's housing market, where Anthropic employees may have enough collective wealth to buy 9% of the city's homes.
